looks.label: Relative-difficulty name marks
looks.technique: signed integer -2..+2 rendered as --- or +++ after the target name, shown only on the current target

looks.label: Sectioned item inspect card
looks.technique: slot line, separator, name, level, up to five value lines, separator, optional spell block gated by bit flags 0x08 and 0x10

looks.label: Filter-then-table item finder
looks.technique: name filter, fixed-width columns (Slot, Quality, Bonus, Name), row selectable across columns, hover card

originals.name: Threat ticks
originals.idea: A five-step tick row above an enemy name showing its level against the hero, from -2 to +2.
originals.keep: signed five-step scale, shown only on the current target
originals.change: our own glyphs with a non-colour cue, readable at 375 wide

originals.name: Loot inspect card
originals.idea: A sectioned card: slot line, level, up to five value lines, then an optional spell block after a separator.
originals.change: tap to inspect on the phone, compare-to-equipped row, our own layout

originals.name: Gear finder panel
originals.idea: Name filter over a table with fixed columns Slot, Quality, Bonus, Name and a detail view.
originals.change: card list on a 375-wide phone, no hover, slot filter chip

originals.name: Fixed body-slot list
originals.idea: A fixed slot set (head, body, neck, hands, feet, cloak, legs, arms, jewel) plus mount and quiver slots held as data.
originals.keep: slot set is data, not code
originals.change: our own slot names for the hero rig, a companion slot in place of horse slots

originals.name: Per-build data folders
originals.idea: One config per build id and a version-scoped module folder over a shared core.
originals.keep: version data in one folder, shared code in another
originals.change: content packs for zones and creatures as catalogue data, not client builds

originals.name: Dev event feed
originals.idea: A rolling list of recent events in a dev-only window.
originals.change: dev toggle, category filters, event IDs that link to the fight replay

originals.name: Banded item IDs
originals.idea: Item type IDs grouped into numeric bands (weapon 1-28, armour 31-38, house 49-71).
originals.keep: numeric bands so a loader can tell categories apart
originals.change: our own band layout with readable IDs in the catalogue
